title: Official Addon E2E Alpha2
problem: Nako's released server, public Addon Protocol crates, GHCR image, and first official companion Addon are published separately but not yet proven as one end-to-end alpha user path.

evidence.summary: Workstream opened after Nako alpha.1 and official metadata scraper alpha.1 publication.
Published Nako GHCR image ran nako-server --help and ffmpeg -version; official metadata scraper built locally and passed direct fixture sidecar smoke.

Added and ran scripts/official-addon-e2e-smoke.ps1. It used the published Nako GHCR image plus the published nako-metadata-scraper 0.1.0-alpha.1 crates.io binary to register, health-check, enable, and call the metadata resource through Nako's hosted Addon runtime.
Added explicit server tests for unsupported Addon Protocol registration and hosted resource response protocol mismatch diagnostics; focused tests and cargo nextest run -p nako-server addon passed.
Updated README, deployment release checklist, and addon author guide to point at scripts/official-addon-e2e-smoke.ps1 as the published alpha host/addon smoke entrypoint.

continue_policy.notes: The official addon alpha2 end-to-end proof is complete. Future work should open separate lanes for Addon Manager, marketplace, package signing, provider breadth, or new protocol compatibility follow-ons.
